items.label: Show this helper
items.details: Toggles this keybinds panel (Noctalia plugin wellington-vell/keybinds).

items.label: Open terminal
items.details: Launches the host terminal (Ghostty).

items.label: Terminal with tmux
items.details: Opens the terminal running a tmux session.

items.label: App launcher
items.details: Toggles the Noctalia launcher panel.

items.label: Run menu
items.details: Opens the host menu app (host.apps.menu).

items.label: File manager
items.details: Opens the host file manager.

items.label: Open browser
items.details: Launches the host browser.

items.label: Open Neovim
items.details: Opens LazyVim in a new terminal.

items.label: Open lazydocker
items.details: Opens lazydocker in a new terminal.

items.label: Close window
items.details: Closes the focused window.

items.label: Universal copy
items.details: Sends Ctrl+C, or Ctrl+Insert when a terminal (Ghostty/kitty/alacritty/foot) is focused, so copy never sends SIGINT.

items.label: Universal paste
items.details: Sends Ctrl+V, or Ctrl+Shift+V in terminals (Ghostty's Shift+Insert reads the primary selection, not the clipboard).

items.label: Clipboard history
items.details: Toggles the Noctalia clipboard panel.

items.label: Control center
items.details: Toggles the Noctalia control center.

items.label: Settings / swap left
items.details: Dwindle layout: toggles Noctalia settings. Scrolling layout: swaps the column to the left.

items.label: Window switcher
items.details: Opens the Noctalia window switcher.

items.label: Toggle floating
items.details: Toggles floating for the focused window.

items.label: Float and pin
items.details: Toggles floating and pins the window so it follows you across workspaces.

items.label: Pseudo tile
items.details: Toggles pseudotiling (keeps the window's own size inside its tile).

items.label: Toggle split
items.details: Flips the dwindle split direction.

items.label: Switch layout
items.details: Toggles between the dwindle and scrolling layouts.

items.label: Fullscreen
items.details: Real fullscreen for the focused window.

items.label: Fake fullscreen
items.details: Tells the app it is fullscreen while it stays tiled.

items.label: Maximize
items.details: Maximizes the window, keeping bar and gaps.

items.label: Move focus
items.details: Focuses the window in that direction.

items.label: Go to workspace
items.details: Switches to workspace 1–10 (0 is 10).

items.label: Move to workspace
items.details: Moves the focused window to workspace 1–10.

items.label: Cycle workspaces
items.details: Mouse wheel moves to the next/previous existing workspace.

items.label: Drag / resize
items.details: Hold SUPER and drag with left button to move, right button to resize.

items.label: Next column
items.details: Scrolling layout: moves the view one column right.

items.label: Swap column right
items.details: Scrolling layout: swaps the column with its right neighbour.

items.label: Resize column
items.details: Scrolling layout: grows (.) or shrinks (,) the column width.

items.label: Region screenshot
items.details: Select a region; the saved toast opens it in Loupe.

items.label: Fullscreen screenshot
items.details: Captures the whole screen (hover to pick a monitor).

items.label: Color picker
items.details: Runs hyprpicker and copies the picked color; press again to cancel.

items.label: Toggle recording
items.details: Starts/stops the screen recorder (hover to pick a screen); the saved toast opens the video.

items.label: Exit Hyprland
items.details: Runs hyprshutdown if available, otherwise exits the compositor.

items.label: Paste clipboard
items.details: Ghostty: pastes the clipboard instead of the primary selection.

items.label: Terminal fullscreen
items.details: Ghostty fullscreen (plain Ctrl+Enter is unbound so it isn't hit by accident).

items.label: tmux prefix
items.details: Primary tmux prefix; CTRL + B also works. Press prefix twice to send it through.

items.label: Split below
items.details: Splits the pane vertically in the current directory (also prefix h).

items.label: Split right
items.details: Splits the pane horizontally in the current directory (also prefix v).

items.label: Kill pane
items.details: Closes the current pane (also prefix x).

items.label: Focus pane
items.details: Moves focus to the pane in that direction.

items.label: Resize pane
items.details: Resizes the pane by 5 cells in that direction.

items.label: Go to window
items.details: Selects tmux window 1–9.

items.label: Prev / next window
items.details: Cycles tmux windows.

items.label: Move window
items.details: Swaps the window left/right and follows it.

items.label: Prev / next session
items.details: Switches tmux sessions (also prefix P / N).

items.label: New window
items.details: Creates a window in the current directory.

items.label: Rename window
items.details: Prompts for a new window name.

items.label: Kill window
items.details: Closes the current window.

items.label: New session
items.details: Creates a session in the current directory.

items.label: Rename session
items.details: Prompts for a new session name.

items.label: Kill session
items.details: Closes the current session.

items.label: Reload config
items.details: Re-sources /etc/tmux.conf.

items.label: Select and copy
items.details: In vi copy mode: v begins a selection, y copies it and exits.

items.label: Find files
items.details: Fuzzy-find files in the project root. <leader> is Space.

items.label: Grep project
items.details: Live grep across the project.

items.label: File explorer
items.details: Toggles the file explorer sidebar.

items.label: Open lazygit
items.details: Full lazygit UI inside Neovim.

items.label: Stash picker
items.details: Lists stashes with a diff preview; Enter runs git stash apply (the stash is kept).

items.label: Stash panel
items.details: Jumps to lazygit's Stash panel; Enter on a stash lists its files.

items.label: Apply one file
items.details: Inside a stash's file list: checks out just that file into the working tree.

items.label: Pop / drop stash
items.details: g applies and removes the stash; d deletes it.

items.label: Restore file from stash
items.details: Full command: :!git restore --source=stash@{0} -- <file>. Takes one file from a stash. Run git stash list for indexes, then :e! to reload the buffer.
